openTo: Seeking a fully funded PhD in AI
summary: I am a Computer Science and Engineering graduate with a deep passion for solving problems through code. Since 2014, I have immersed myself in competitive programming, which has sharpened my ability to think critically and design efficient algorithms.

Alongside this, I have developed a strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and computer vision — areas where I have gained hands-on experience through academic research projects and self-driven learning. I enjoy exploring how data and intelligent systems can solve real-world problems, and I am always looking for opportunities to grow, collaborate and build meaningful technology.

Today I work as an Advanced ICT Officer at CNRS-UNHCR, where I teach students and apply technology in a humanitarian context — and I have written a free, university-level curriculum of 273 lectures on AI, Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
researchStatement: My research interests centre on computer vision and deep learning for real-world safety and human understanding — particularly in the context of developing countries such as Bangladesh. My undergraduate research tackled pedestrian detection with risk-level classification for Bangladeshi road scenes and vision-based vehicle over-speed detection. My co-authored paper on real-time facial-expression analysis with YOLOv11 was published by Springer Nature in 2026 (Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems), and I am now benchmarking modern YOLO detectors for blood-cell microscopy. I am seeking a PhD position where I can develop robust, efficient and fair vision models that work reliably outside benchmark conditions — for road safety, humanitarian applications and education.

news.text: Launched JaniX, my learning platform with courses, quizzes, certificates and payments, and recorded its first course: Machine Learning, Basics to Intermediate, in Bangla with English subtitles.

Submitted our paper “Do Newer Nano YOLO Detectors Help Blood-Cell Detection? A Multi-Seed Benchmark with Corruptions, Ensembles, Slicing and CPU Deployment” to IEEE ISBI 2027, with Huzzatul Jannat Shethil and Jamon A Aranna.
Launched this portfolio and published The AI Lecture Hall — 273 free lectures on AI, ML and Deep Learning.
Published “Emotion Detection at Lightning Speed: Leveraging YOLOv11 for Facial Expression Analysis” in Springer Nature’s Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems (ICCTRDA 2025).
Graduated with a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology.
